entityDescription: Streamline Systems Ltd is a Cambridge-based SME developing resilient, GPS-independent positioning, navigation and timing (PNT) technology for UAVs, autonomous systems and Critical National Infrastructure. Our core technology uses networks of low-cost radio modules that range off one another to establish a shared terrestrial reference frame, delivering centimetre-level positioning without reliance on GNSS. The system provides resilient navigation in environments where satellite signals are degraded, denied or electronically contested. The technology has reached TRL 6, developed in-house, with demonstrated autonomous waypoint navigation and position hold in the absence of GPS or manual input. The company holds an integration partnership with a UK drone OEM and is advised by senior figures from UK defence and national metrology. Streamline Systems' capabilities span PNT systems engineering, radio-frequency hardware, embedded firmware and autonomous navigation.

entityDescription:
Raysilience is an Italian company operating in the field of resilient navigation and autonomy for uncrewed systems. The company develops technology that enables autonomous vehicles to determine their absolute position and continue their mission when satellite navigation is degraded, denied, jammed or spoofed - a capability increasingly recognised as critical across security, surveillance, public safety and civil aviation applications.

Its activity is a downstream space application: Raysilience converts georeferenced Earth Observation imagery into an onboard navigation reference layer, allowing absolute positioning to be recovered independently of live GNSS signals. This approach establishes a new operational use case for Earth Observation data and for the European infrastructures that produce it.

The company's first solution, MONDRIAN, targets small and medium uncrewed aerial systems and is designed as an open, platform-agnostic subsystem for integration by manufacturers, system integrators and mission-critical operators, rather than as a closed vertical product. Its development is supported by an industrial Proof of Concept Contract with Leonardo S.p.A. Autonomous System Lab, and by recognition within European innovation programmes, including the CASSINI Hackathon for Space and Defence, the EUDIS Hackathon. Raysilience won the Telespazio S.p.A. T-TeC award.

Raysilience is fully European from the ground up by design: ITAR-free, aligned with Copernicus and European Earth Observation infrastructures, and positioned to contribute to Europe's strategic autonomy in assured positioning, navigation and timing.

entityDescription:
Mapx Tech Kft. is a young Hungarian startup founded by Zsolt Perőcsényi with the mission to make Earth Observation (EO) data accessible and actionable for the general public. We aim to bridge the gap between raw satellite imagery and easy-to-understand, decision-ready information products.
Our focus areas include climate change adaptation and precision agriculture, two domains where timely, localized EO insights can drive significant impact. By leveraging AI and machine learning techniques, our mission is to process multi-spectral data from Sentinel and other EO missions into intuitive visualizations, interactive web apps, and alert services.
Some of our planned products include:
- Drought and vegetation stress monitoring for farmers and agricultural insurers- Flood and water level change detection for river basin authorities- Urban heat island and land-use change analytics for city planners- Forestry and wildfire risk assessment for forest managers
Our goal is to democratize access to planetary-scale EO data by presenting it in formats that integrate seamlessly into users' existing workflows, from interactive maps embedded into news articles to ML-powered analytics dashboards for specialist users. We envision our products enabling better-informed decisions from the farm field to the policy desk.
As a lean startup, we are looking to the ESA BIC program for access to technical expertise, computing resources, and the unparalleled EO data pipeline of the Copernicus program. With the right support, we are confident we can grow into an innovative EO data analytics provider in the CEE region and beyond.
We are excited for the opportunity to join the ESA community and accelerate our journey from concept to impact.

entityName: Big Data Research and Innovation Excellence
description:
BI-REX (Big Data Innovation & Research Excellence) is one of the Italian Competence Centers established under the Industry 4.0 national plan. BI-REX supports companies in research, innovation, technology transfer, and the adoption of advanced digital and manufacturing technologies through collaborative R&D projects, testing facilities, training, and consultancy services.

The Competence Center operates a state-of-the-art pilot line and advanced laboratories covering additive manufacturing, printed and hybrid electronics, industrial automation, artificial intelligence, machine learning, digital twins, industrial IoT, big data analytics, cybersecurity, edge and cloud computing, and advanced simulation. BI-REX collaborates with universities, research organizations, SMEs, and large enterprises to accelerate the development and industrialization of innovative technologies.

Company description: The University of Cassino and Southern Lazio (UNICAS) was established in 1979 as a response to the educational needs represented by an area characterized by a growing focus on innovation and cultural and social promotion. Due to its geographical location, UNICAS serves as a natural hub between the cities of southern Lazio, Campania, Molise and Abruzzo, from which it channels most of its students.
The University Community of the University consists of more than thirteen thousand people:
- 12,525 students enrolled in study courses and Postgraduate paths (a.y. 2021/2022);
- 275 faculty and researchers;
- 254 managers, technical and administrative staff;
- 9 staff and language experts;
- 122 PhD students;
- 42 research fellows.
Teaching and research activities take place mainly at the Cassino campus; 2 undergraduate and 2 master's degree courses in economics and engineering disciplines are hosted at the Frosinone decentralized pole, in order to contribute to the development of an increasingly fruitful interaction with the territory.
At the Gaeta campus, on the other hand, conference, public engagement and technology transfer activities are concentrated, as well as some continuing education activities.
The University provides paths for teaching qualification, structured according to current regulations. Services to students are provided through the 3 area libraries (economic-legal, engineering, humanities), the University Center for Orientation (CUOri), the University Center for Disability, Inclusion and Research (CUDIR), the Center for International Relations (CRI), The University Center for Information Services (CASI), and the Job Placement Office, at which an Information Desk is active, an interface between students, undergraduates and graduates with the world of work.
Teaching is supported by a lively and qualified research activity, developed within the Departments in all the fields of interest of the University (antiquistics, historical-artistic studies, historical, linguistic, philological-literary, paleographic-codicological, pedagogy and social service; mechanical, management, civil, environmental, electrical, computer, telecommunications engineering; economic, business and legal disciplines; motor and health sciences), with results of average high quality and peaks of national and international visibility and excellence. Research activities are supported by the presence of highly specialized laboratories, which are functional for the development of projects carried out also in the framework of national and international collaborations and for the release of technological consultancy for the benefit of institutions, entities and industries.
The research infrastructure and related equipment provided by the University is an important support for researchers' participation in competitive calls.

entityDescription: Slot Consulting is a research and innovation-focused consulting company. entityDescription:
The Chair of Real-time Systms RPTU carries out research regarding timeliness issues in embedded computing systems and networks, as well as cyberphysical cloud systems.
In these, results are considered correct when not only the functional correctness (value) is achieved, but also the time at they are produced.
Application areas include automotive, avionics, and railway systems.
A focus of research on the safe integration of safety critical and non safety critical activities on shared computing platforms and networks and cloud computing continuum.
